method: StandardScaler → K-Means (k by silhouette) · PCA for display

rules.label: Defensive Compression
rules.rule: out of possession (share ≤ 0.4), width Δ and area Δ ≤ −0.5σ

rules.label: Defensive Shift
rules.rule: out of possession, lateral shift ≥ 0.5σ, |area Δ| < 0.5σ

rules.label: Wing Expansion
rules.rule: in possession (share ≥ 0.6), width Δ and area Δ ≥ 0.5σ

rules.label: Local Overload
rules.rule: players ≤10 m of ball or ball-area density ≥ 0.75σ
